page.title: Test mode
page.description: Try the public page and payments without polluting your data: test bookings are excluded from reports and corrispettivi and can be deleted in bulk.

banner.title: Test mode is on
banner.description: Bookings and payments created now are test data: excluded from reports, KPIs, corrispettivi and exports. The public page accepts bookings only from the preview link.
banner.descriptionPublic: Bookings and payments created now are test data, including those made by customers on the public page: excluded from reports, KPIs, corrispettivi and exports.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: While test mode is on, everything created (panel, public page preview, API) is marked as test.
switch.enabledHint: Turn it off before you start working with real customers.
switch.publicHint: Without this option the public page accepts bookings only from the preview link; real customers see a notice.
switch.publicWarningTitle: Not recommended once the public page is in use
switch.publicWarning: Real customers can book, but their bookings are test data: excluded from the figures and deletable in bulk.

stripe.configuredTitle: Online payments with the test keys
stripe.configured: Stripe automatically uses the test configuration while test mode is on: no real charges.
stripe.missing: While test mode is on, online payments are disabled (pay on site). Add the test keys in Settings > Payments to try them.

preview.title: Public page preview
preview.description: A signed link, valid for 2 hours, to make test bookings from the public page.
preview.needsEnabled: Turn test mode on to create the preview link.
preview.hint: Create the link and open it on this or another device.

purge.title: Test bookings
purge.description: Permanently delete the test bookings with their allocations, payments and messages. Real bookings are never touched; the activity log stays.
purge.confirmDescription: {{bookings}} test bookings and {{payments}} test payments will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
purge.done: Deleted {{bookings}} test bookings and {{payments}} test payments
